items.label: Urban Unmarked Road Speed Limit
items.value: 50 km/h

items.label: Slow Lane & Narrow Undivided Road Speed Limit
items.value: 40 km/h

items.label: Railroad Level Crossing Approach Speed
items.value: 15 km/h or less (Stop if red light flashes or bells ring)

items.label: Adverse Weather on Freeway (<100m visibility)
items.value: Reduce speed to under 40 km/h or pull into service area

items.label: Dangerous Driving Speed Violation Threshold
items.value: Exceeding speed limit by 40+ km/h (NT$6k–36k + license suspension)

items.label: Freeway Small Car Safe Following Distance
items.value: Speed (km/h) ÷ 2 in meters (e.g. 100 km/h = 50m; Double in rain/fog)

items.label: Freeway Large Vehicle Safe Following Distance
items.value: Speed (km/h) - 50 in meters (e.g. 100 km/h = 50m)

items.label: Speed vs. Braking Distance Physics
items.value: Braking distance ∝ Speed² (Doubling speed = 4x longer braking distance)

items.label: Reaction Time Distance Physics
items.value: Reaction distance increases directly proportionally to speed (linear)

items.label: Turn Signal Advance Distance
items.value: Must signal at least 30 meters prior to turning or changing lanes

items.label: Pedestrian Crosswalk Safe Buffer
items.value: Stop and yield at least 3 meters (approx. 4 zebra stripes) before crosswalk

items.label: Freeway Breakdown Warning Triangle Distance
items.value: Place triangle 100 meters behind vehicle (30–100m on regular roads)

items.label: Highway Emergency Triangle in Heavy Fog/Rain
items.value: Place triangle 100 to 200 meters behind vehicle

category: 🍷 2. Alcohol BAC Limits, DUI Offenses & Passenger Penalties

items.label: Administrative Fine BAC Threshold
items.value: 0.15 mg/L breath alcohol (or 0.03% blood alcohol)

items.label: Criminal Offense Prosecution BAC Threshold
items.value: 0.25 mg/L breath alcohol (or 0.05% blood alcohol)

items.label: First-Time Car Drunk Driving Fine
items.value: NT$30,000 to NT$120,000 + License suspension for 1 to 2 years

items.label: Refusing Sobriety Breathalyzer Test Penalty
items.value: NT$180,000 fine + Instant license revocation + Vehicle impoundment

items.label: Second Refusal to Sobriety Test (within 10 yrs)
items.value: NT$360,000 fine + Instant revocation + Public disclosure

items.label: Repeat Drunk Driving Window (10 Years)
items.value: Maximum fine + License revocation + Public photo/name disclosure

items.label: Passenger Riding with Drunk Driver Penalty
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$15,000 fine for passengers 18+ (except seniors 70+)

items.label: DUI Involving Severe Injury or Death
items.value: Permanent driver license revocation + Lifetime ban from retesting

items.label: Ignition Interlock (Alcohol Lock) Mandate
items.value: Mandatory installation upon re-applying for license after DUI revocation

category: 📱 3. Traffic Fines, Demerit Points & License Laws

items.label: Demerit Points License Suspension Threshold
items.value: Accumulating 12 demerit points within 1 year = 2-month suspension

items.label: Running a Red Light Fine
items.value: NT$1,800 to NT$5,400 fine + 3 demerit points

items.label: Operating Handheld Mobile Device (Car Driver)
items.value: NT$3,000 fine (prohibited while vehicle is in motion)

items.label: Failing to Yield to Pedestrians on Crosswalk
items.value: NT$1,200 to NT$6,000 fine + 3 demerit points + 3h safety class

items.label: Failing to Yield to Emergency Sirens (Ambulance)
items.value: NT$3,600 fine + Mandatory driver license revocation

items.label: Leaving Child Under 6 Unattended in Car
items.value: NT$3,000 fine + 4 hours road traffic safety training class

items.label: Driving Without a Valid Driver's License
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$24,000 fine + Immediate vehicle impoundment

items.label: Driving With Suspended or Revoked License
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$24,000 fine + Immediate vehicle impoundment

items.label: Lending Driver's License to Another Person
items.value: Driver's license suspended for 3 months

items.label: Hit-and-Run Fleeing Scene (Injury or Death)
items.value: Driver license permanently revoked + Criminal prosecution

items.label: Three Violations in 3 Months (Vehicle Penalty)
items.value: Suspension of vehicle license plate for 1 month

items.label: Professional License Review Cycle (<60 yrs)
items.value: Reviewed once every 3 years from date of issuance

items.label: Elderly Drivers (75+ yrs) License Renewal
items.value: Must pass physical + cognitive dementia test every 3 years

items.label: Intersection Right-of-Way Priority #1
items.value: Straight-going vehicle has absolute priority over turning vehicle

items.label: Intersection Right-of-Way Priority #2
items.value: Left-turning vehicle MUST yield to Right-turning vehicle

items.label: Uncontrolled / Equal Intersections
items.value: Vehicle on left must yield to vehicle approaching from RIGHT side

items.label: Roundabout Traffic Right-of-Way
items.value: Vehicles entering roundabout MUST yield to vehicles already circulating inside

items.label: T-Intersection Priority
items.value: Vehicle on stem of T-intersection must yield to cross traffic on main road

items.label: Solid Double Yellow Lines
items.value: Strictly prohibited to cross, overtake, or make U-turns 24 hours a day

items.label: Solid White Line (Lane Separation)
items.value: Prohibited from changing lanes across solid white line

items.label: Yellow Diagonal Crosshatch Area
items.value: Prohibited from stopping or parking inside grid at all times

items.label: Zig-zag Lines on Pavement (Zebra approach)
items.value: Indicates pedestrian crosswalk ahead; driver must slow down

items.label: Two-Stage Door Opening Protocol (Art. 112)
items.value: 1. Look back and open door ~15 cm → 2. Check clear → 3. Open and exit

items.label: Solid Red Curb Line Marking
items.value: Prohibited from stopping or parking 24 hours a day

items.label: Solid Yellow Curb Line Marking
items.value: Temporary stopping (<3 min) allowed; No parking from 7 AM to 8 PM

items.label: Parking Distance from Road Edge / Curb
items.value: Right wheels must be within 40 cm of curb (within 60 cm for temp stopping)

items.label: Prohibited Stopping Zone Distance
items.value: Prohibited within 10 meters of intersections, bus stops, fire hydrants

items.label: Child Under 2 Years Old Safety Seat
items.value: Mandatory REAR-FACING child safety seat placed in REAR seat

items.label: Child 2 to 4 Years Old (<18 kg) Safety Seat
items.value: Mandatory child safety seat installed in REAR seat

items.label: Child Under 12 Years Old Seating Law
items.value: Prohibited from riding in front passenger seat (must sit in rear)

items.label: Minimum Tire Tread Depth (Automobile)
items.value: 1.6 mm (failing depth results in failed inspection and hydroplaning)

items.label: Exhaust Smoke: Bluish-White Smoke
items.value: Indicates engine oil leaking into cylinders and burning

items.label: Exhaust Smoke: Thick White Smoke / Steam
items.value: Indicates coolant/water leaking into combustion chamber

items.label: Exhaust Smoke: Dense Black Smoke
items.value: Indicates incomplete fuel combustion (too rich air-fuel mixture)

items.label: Low Engine Oil Pressure Warning Light
items.value: Stop vehicle immediately in safe place and shut off engine

items.label: Brake Fade on Long Downhill Mountain Slope
items.value: Shift to lower gear to utilize engine braking (avoid riding brakes)

items.label: Tire Blowout while Driving Response
items.value: Grip steering wheel firmly, do NOT slam on brakes, decelerate smoothly

items.label: Vehicle Towing Rope Standard
items.value: Rope length between 3 and 5 meters with a yellow flag in middle

category: 🚑 7. First Aid, CPR & Emergency Crash Response

items.label: First Aid Medical Emergency Priority
items.value: 1. Open Airway (A) → 2. Control Bleeding (B) → 3. Circulation & Fractures (C)

items.label: Adult CPR Compression to Ventilation Ratio
items.value: 30 Chest Compressions to 2 Rescue Breaths (30:2)

items.label: Adult CPR Chest Compression Rate & Depth
items.value: 100 to 120 compressions per minute; 5 to 6 cm compression depth

items.label: Suspected Cervical Spine / Neck Trauma Airway
items.value: Jaw-Thrust maneuver only (do NOT tilt head or twist neck)

items.label: Irreversible Brain Damage Time Window
items.value: Irreversible brain damage occurs after 4 to 6 minutes without oxygen

items.label: Railroad Crossing Breakdown 3-Step SOS
items.value: 1. Press Red Emergency SOS Button → 2. Push car clear → 3. Evacuate
